content:
Task t1 completed: Closed self-approval bypass in firestore.rules. 

Changes made:
- Added field-level restrictions to `/users/{userId}` preventing users from modifying `status` and `role` fields
- Owner can read/write their own document EXCEPT status/role
- Owner can create their own document WITHOUT status/role
- Admins/owners (via custom claims) can write all fields including status/role

No client code changes required - AdminService already validates `_isAdmin` before writing status/role, and AuthService only reads these fields.
